meta_description: Automotive and discrete plants chase three numbers — OEE, escapes and launch time.

blocks.x: Automotive & Discrete Manufacturing: the operating units, priority programs and the five capability towers that matter most here.

The workflows we industrialize here: Line changeover sequencing, Vision inspection, Predictive maintenance, IATF traceability, Energy management. Each arrives with its current cycle times measured in the Diagnose phase, and each leaves the program governed by outcome SLOs rather than anecdotes.

items: Legacy lines uninstrumented; OEE components and energy per unit are estimates.
Defect detection by eyes/sampling; escapes reach customers and recalls cost millions.
Body-shop and assembly sequencing by spreadsheet; changeover minutes bleed OEE.
IATF lot traceability assembled from documents; recall scoping takes days.
OT/IT convergence without segmentation; ransomware stops lines.
Job-shop complexity exceeds solver ceilings; better sequences exist but can't be found in time.

blocks.x: How we help — five priority capabilities

items: Retrofit sensing on live lines with governed telemetry — OEE components real
Defect detection closed into andon/MES holds: escapes down sharply
Goal-directed agents that run inside your systems with defined roles, budgets and human checkpoints. Every action is logged, measurable and reversible.
OPC UA/MES/quality unified with lineage: root cause in hours
IEC 62443 zones with monitoring: line-stopping risk contained

blocks.x: A typical program here starts with a two-week diagnostic that measures the workflows named above and locks the baseline, moves through a gated proof on your data, then industrializes on platform rails with the sector's compliance evidence generated in-flight.

items: OEE +7.2 points across 14 plants: sensor network to scheduling decisions
Yield +3.4 points and energy per tonne down 17% — APC augmentation program
